name: ai_assist_duration_factor
unit: share of conventional minutes per touch
basis: REV2: field evidence ~14% faster (Brynjolfsson et al. customer support) to ~3% hours (Humlum & Vestergaard); 0.6 only in lab (Noy & Zhang). Native minutes in events.csv were calibrated at 0.6 and are rescaled

name: fail_mult_automated
basis: REV2 (CHL-061/107): no assumed failure benefit from automation; correlated automation errors possible

name: software_per_account_licensed
basis: Ren software price ~$81 per account (NCF; charity-network 20); band assumed

name: sponsor_reserved_min_per_account
basis: PR87 report 06 (OPS 2.7; COM 7.0) borne by sponsor in every mode

name: avg_balance
basis: servicing-economics segment-summary band ($150-700k targets; $100-250k model B)

name: prevention_scale
basis: REV2 (CHL-060): half efficacy until bank/custodian partners (virtual accounts, positive pay, fund references) are contracted

name: touch_mult_native
basis: No measured exception rates (FIE 11; charity-network E13)

name: duration_mult_native
unit: multiplier on native minutes per touch

name: activity_mult
basis: ACT frequency low/high bands (grants 5.6-18.5 per account)

name: sponsor_efficiency_multiplier
unit: multiplier on sponsor-borne event minutes in licensing modes
basis: REV2 (CHL architect): sponsor staff at low volume without specialist tooling are less efficient than a dedicated operator

name: fixed_cost_mult
basis: REV2 (CHL CFO): fixed cost outranks balance and belongs in the tornado

name: amortisation_years
basis: REV2 (CHL CFO): fully loaded break-even amortises build, CAC and onboarding

name: utilisation
basis: REV2 (CHL-034/109): queue coverage, PTO and segregation of duties prevent perfectly divisible labour
